characters.name: Riya
characters.description: 27, product manager, oversized grey hoodie, hair in a clip
characters.continuity: Grey hoodie, claw clip, same mug throughout

continuity: Mug: white ceramic, same in every shot
Bottle cap removed in scene 3, stays off

scenes.visual: Laptop clock flips 9:57 to 9:58. Riya's hand freezes over an empty mug.
scenes.sync_note: She says the time as we see it

scenes.visual: Riya opens the fridge, grabs the Brewly bottle [USE ACTUAL PACK], label to camera.

dialogue.line: Okay. Plan B. Actually, plan A.

scenes.sync_note: Line lands as she sees the bottle

scenes.visual: She pours the concentrate over ice, tops up with milk, stirs once.
scenes.vo: Pour, add milk, done. One bottle makes 10 cups.
scenes.sync_note: Each verb matches the action on screen

scenes.visual: Riya sits as the call connects, sips, unmutes calmly. Bottle on desk, label to camera.
